_comment: Klondike Solitaire locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. NEVER translate card labels/suits (e.g. A, 10, K, ♣️, ♦️, ♥️, ♠️), the pile tokens W, F1-F4, T1-T7, the ASCII board in {board}, or the commands 'draw', 'move', 'forfeit', 'all'. The bracket syntax like 'move W T1' must stay in Latin as-is.

_slots.{n}: Action index within a comma-separated command, 1-based
_slots.{msg}: A nested per-action result message (already localized)
_slots.{count}: Number of face-up cards being moved
_slots.{cmd}: The unknown command the player typed (not translated)
_slots.{max_turns}: The maximum number of turns before the game ends
_slots.{score}: Number of cards currently in the foundation piles
_slots.{stock}: Number of cards left in the stock
_slots.{waste}: The top waste card label, or '--' if empty (never translate)
_slots.{cards}: The cards in a pile as neutral labels, or '--' if empty (never translate)

player_prompt.intro:
Kamoe ta lhee game Solitaire Klondike. Tujuan kamoe nyan keu peubloe kartu mandum u foundation piles.

Peuraton Game:
- Foundation piles (F1-F4): Peubloe naek nibak Ace keu Raja lam suit
- Tableau piles (T1-T7): Peubloe turun ngon warna selang-seling (mirah atawa itam, itam atawa mirah)
- Stock: Tarik kartu u waste pile
- Waste (W): Kartu paling aseh keu dimainkan

Peuraton:
- 'draw' - Tarik kartu nibak stock u waste
- 'move <source> <destination> [count]' - Pindah kartu antara piles
  Contoh: 'move W T1', 'move T1 F2', 'move T3 T5 2'. Count juga jeuët 'all', nyang jeuët meupindah kartu mandum nyang ka tupeue.
- 'forfeit' - Akhiri game langsung ngon kunci skor kamoe jinoe
- Nan pile: W (waste), F1-F4 (foundations), T1-T7 (tableau)

Kamoe jeuët jalan saboh peuraton leubeh nibak sa'at ngon meukirajih ngon koma:
  Contoh: 'draw, move W T1, move T2 F1'

Raja jeuët teupeue lam tableau piles nyang kosong.
Peuraton jeuët jalan ngon tertib - meu'én saboh gagal, peuraton la'én jeuët dileupah.
Peuguna 'forfeit' meu'én kamoe yakin game nyan han jeuet keumeunang.
